newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Narrow range trade was the main activity today as most people were hesitant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.
"I think the market is going to stay around current levels for the time being or until we see some fresh (U.S. economic) indicators," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
